_comment: Thresholds/weights. Each entry is { "value": number, "calibratedOn": string }. Calibrate on $WINNOW_FIXTURES, never guess. Measured values go in NOTES.md.

previewMinLongSide.calibratedOn: PROVISIONAL (Phase 3): not yet measured on fixtures. Recalibrate in Phase 4 from preview-vs-full-res sharpness on $WINNOW_FIXTURES.

analysisMaxSide.calibratedOn: PROVISIONAL (Phase 4): analysis parameter, not yet measured on $WINNOW_FIXTURES. Long side of the downscaled image metrics run on.

sharpnessTileSize.calibratedOn: PROVISIONAL (Phase 4): analysis parameter, not yet measured on $WINNOW_FIXTURES. Tile edge in px at analysisMaxSide.

sharpnessPercentile.calibratedOn: PROVISIONAL (Phase 4): analysis parameter, not yet measured on $WINNOW_FIXTURES. Shot sharpness = this percentile of tile Tenengrad, so a sharp subject on a soft background still counts.

noiseFlatTileFraction.calibratedOn: PROVISIONAL (Phase 4): analysis parameter, not yet measured on $WINNOW_FIXTURES. Share of lowest-gradient tiles used for the noise estimate.

shadowClipLevel.calibratedOn: PROVISIONAL (Phase 4): analysis parameter, not yet measured on $WINNOW_FIXTURES. Luma (0-255) at or below which a pixel counts as crushed.

highlightClipLevel.calibratedOn: PROVISIONAL (Phase 4): analysis parameter, not yet measured on $WINNOW_FIXTURES. Luma (0-255) at or above which a pixel counts as clipped.
